termsIntro: These Terms govern access to and use of SirRelay, a hosted task service for small teams (web app, optional Telegram, and optional editor or MCP clients). By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms.
privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how SirRelay collects and uses personal data when you use our hosted web app, optional Telegram integration, and optional editor or MCP clients that use a link token.

terms.title: 1. Acceptance
terms.body: If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use SirRelay. If you use the service on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you have authority to bind that organisation.

terms.title: 2. The service
terms.body: SirRelay helps small groups coordinate tasks via a web app, an optional Telegram bot, and optional clients (VS Code / Cursor extension, MCP) that use a link token you create while signed in. Features may change as the product evolves. SirRelay is not a general messaging platform, CRM, or guaranteed enterprise SLA.

terms.title: 3. Accounts
terms.body: You must provide accurate account details and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account. Operators are responsible for who they invite into a group and for content they create or assign.

terms.title: 4. Acceptable use
terms.body: You may not misuse the service: no unlawful content, no attempts to break security or access other groups’ data, no abuse of Telegram or our infrastructure. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.

terms.title: 5. Telegram
terms.body: Telegram features depend on Telegram’s availability and your link between SirRelay and Telegram. We are not responsible for Telegram outages, policy changes, or account bans on Telegram’s side.

terms.title: 6. Availability
terms.body: We aim for reliable hosting but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Keep your own copies of critical information where needed.

terms.title: 7. Liability
terms.body: SirRelay is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties and are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

terms.title: 8. Termination
terms.body: You may stop using the service, leave or delete groups, and permanently delete your account from Profile (Delete account → password confirmation). Deleting your account removes your personal account data; group ownership may transfer to remaining members, and tasks assigned to you are removed. We may suspend or terminate access for breach of these Terms or to protect the service and other users.

terms.title: 9. Changes
terms.body: We may update these Terms. The version identifier and “Last updated” date will change when we do. Continued use after changes, or explicit re-acceptance when prompted, means you accept the updated Terms.

privacy.title: 1. Who is responsible
privacy.body: SirRelay is operated as a hosted service. The operator of your deployment is the controller of personal data processed for that instance.

privacy.title: 2. Data we collect
privacy.body: Account data (email, name, password hash, locale), group and task data, optional Telegram link data, session and security logs, and optional self-hosted usage analytics when enabled.

privacy.title: 3. Why we use data
privacy.body: To provide and secure the service, send task and alert messages you enable, maintain operations, and—if analytics are enabled—understand aggregate product usage. We do not use your data for advertising.

privacy.title: 4. Cookies
privacy.body: We use one essential cookie for your signed-in session. We do not use advertising cookies.

privacy.title: 5. Analytics
privacy.body: When enabled, we run self-hosted Umami on our infrastructure. The tracker is designed to avoid advertising cookies and does not sell your data to third-party ad networks.

privacy.title: 6. Telegram
privacy.body: Linking Telegram is optional. Telegram’s own privacy policy also applies to data Telegram processes as an independent service.

privacy.title: 7. Retention and security
privacy.body: We keep data while your account and groups remain active. After you delete your account, we remove account data from the live system promptly; copies may remain for a reasonable period in backups, security logs, and legal obligations.

privacy.title: 8. Sharing
privacy.body: We do not sell personal data. We may share data with infrastructure providers needed to host the service, with Telegram when you use bot features, or when required by law.

privacy.title: 9. Your rights
privacy.body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data. You can permanently delete your account from Profile (Delete account). For other requests, contact us using the address published in the product.
